subject: english-language
title: Nouns and Verbs in Depth
welcome_lead: Go deeper than 'naming words' and 'doing words'.
meta_desc: KS3 English Language adventure on proper/common nouns and transitive verbs.
final_note: You can now classify nouns and verbs with finer detail.

walkthroughs.body_html: Proper nouns ('London', 'Sara') always take a capital. Common nouns ('city', 'girl') don't, unless they start a sentence.
Abstract nouns name ideas ('love', 'fear'). Concrete nouns name physical things ('chair', 'sand').
A transitive verb takes a direct object: 'She kicked the ball.' An intransitive verb doesn't: 'She arrived.'
